nodes.rationale: Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads BOM-less scripts in the ANSI code page, so any non-ASCII character in a .ps1 file fails the build.

nodes.rationale: Signing only runs when WINDOWS_SIGNING_PFX is set, so forks without the secret publish an unsigned exe (SmartScreen warning) instead of failing.

nodes.label: deployer-deploy.zip release asset
nodes.rationale: Zips deploy/ (including sidecar build contexts) and installer/ but never deploy/.env; the build asserts deploy/tunnel/Dockerfile is present.

nodes.label: Pre-paint theme bootstrap (localStorage deployer.theme)
nodes.rationale: Inline script applies the dark class from localStorage or the system preference before the app loads, avoiding a light/dark flash.

nodes.rationale: Git checkout only, never used by the installer. The dashboard stays served from its image; use npm run dev in dashboard/ for hot reload.

nodes.label: mariadb service
nodes.rationale: Row-based binlog kept 8 days enables point-in-time recovery; 512m cap for old PCs

nodes.label: mongodb service (replica set rs0)
nodes.rationale: Single-node replica set so the oplog enables point-in-time recovery; only starts under the mongodb profile because MongoDB 8.0 needs AVX

nodes.label: worker service
nodes.rationale: Gets the Docker socket and runs as root because whoever holds the socket is root-equivalent anyway; the API container keeps no socket

nodes.label: caddy service (single front door)
nodes.rationale: Entrypoint writes the tunnel network subnet so :8081 trusts Cf-Connecting-Ip only from the tunnel network

nodes.label: tunnel service (cloudflared)
nodes.rationale: Defaults to HTTP/2 over TCP 443 because QUIC on UDP 7844 is often dropped by routers and the WSL NAT

nodes.label: backend network (internal, no internet)
nodes.rationale: Databases sit on an internal network without internet access; api and worker also join the public network for outbound calls such as OAuth and external databases.

nodes.label: Memory limits sized for 4 GB PCs
nodes.rationale: Per-service mem_limit defaults, all overridable in .env, total roughly 2.6 GB worst case with typical idle well under 1 GB.
nodes.norm_label: memory limits sized for 4 gb pcs

nodes.label: MongoDB behind a compose profile (AVX-dependent)
nodes.rationale: MongoDB 5.0 needs AVX; the installer omits the profile on CPUs without it and sets MANAGED_MONGODB_ENABLED=false, and api/worker depends_on mongodb is required:false so they do not block.
